service_account_serial.semantics: service-account authentication plus separate serial license material; neither presence nor authentication alone proves editor license authorization

offline_file.semantics: lawfully supplied offline license material; presence requires later effective license validation

floating.semantics: lawfully supplied floating-license client configuration; presence requires later reachable-server/license validation

github_token.semantics: credential must later prove effective authorized access to EpicGames/UnrealEngine exact 5.8 identity; current-repository GITHUB_TOKEN is not assumed sufficient

preseed.semantics: lawfully supplied exact preseed location plus cryptographic expected identity; presence requires later retrieval/version validation

overall_unlock_rule: Only a separately reviewed effective-validation path may unlock one fresh five-candidate W2-ENG empirical episode after both provider inputs are actually validated. This presence-only contract can never unlock it.
